reason: The excerpt says the standardized shapes distinguish the two hot spot types; it does not claim that confusion is eliminated or that the distinction has been proven effective.
sourceEvidence: A circle or ellipse marks a ground-movement hot spot; a cylinder marks a wrong-surface hot spot. Standardized depiction is intended to prevent confusion.
synthesisStatement: A circle or ellipse marks a ground movement hot spot; a cylinder marks a wrong surface hot spot. The stated purpose is to prevent confusion about the meaning or depiction of hot spots.
narrativeStatement: Het onderscheid tussen die vormen maakt duidelijk welk type risicoplek de kaart aanduidt.
